newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Econ says rights issue over-subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Econ says rights issue over-subscribed.

text.p: Construction firm Econ International Ltd said on Monday a one for two rights issue which closed on January 7 had been over-subscribed by 3.56 percent.
Econ said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Singapore it had received shareholder acceptances for 57.2 million shares and excess applications for 17 million.
The issue was set for between 71.6 million and 85.6 million ordinary shares of Singapore $0.20 at S$1.22 per rights share on the basis of one rights share for every two existing ordinary shares held.
Econ said acceptances and applications totalled 74.2 million shares. It said the balance of rights shares not accepted by shareholders would be used to satisfy excess applications.
